Our Story

A sanctuary for the senses.

Nestled in the heart of Prayagraj, Cafe Meraki is more than a café — it is a feeling. Sun-drenched terraces, botanically adorned corners, and a kitchen where Continental, Mexican and Asian flavours collide beautifully.

We brew exclusively with Blue Tokai's single-origin beans, bake our croissants at dawn, and roll sushi the moment you order. Nothing here is rushed — least of all you.
